artboards.title: M4 · Reveal — not quite, both explained
M6 · Resolved — your line joins the story

annotations.text:
Read with Plans/immersive-story-mode.md (MVP re-scope) and the teardown docs. Top row: the golden path M1→M6. Bottom row: the honest edges (offline, recap) + motion.

Everything is drawn from shipped components: HalmOptionSelect cells, ReviewOptionSurface roles, GlassSurface, Theme tokens, AppAnimation springs.

M1 — §14.4: mode choice lives on the preview card, nowhere else (teardown: missions must not become their own tab). Framed as HOW to experience this story, not exercise types. Objectives preview = the acts as speech acts (Mishka ★3). No AI branding on the mode — research: AI is a supporter, not a core.

M2 — §7 rules 1+3: scene, situation and all 3 lines in one glance; the mission line stays pinned. Options are the ONE option idiom (HalmOptionSelect: white cells, brand wash, r18, ≥60pt). One tap answers — no Check step. Every word is tappable (popup-on-all-surfaces is P1); correct line never revealed before the tap (Polinu).

M3 — §7 rule 2: tap → rationale, synchronously (isCorrect is stored; no model at answer time). Focus collapse: siblings recede 0.35/0.96. Rationale = the eyebrow-over-body panel, compact and in-frame (never a half-screen sheet). Plain-words why — register, not „Grammatik“. Tell me more → existing .sentenceExplanation ladder.

M4 — §7.1 (owner-confirmed): wrong pick reveals BOTH rationales in the same frame, correct line marked, no retry — two movements either way. Diff-view teaching (Mishka ★5): why yours fails + the line that works. Wrong picks never touch FSRS. Haptics: error informational, never punishing copy.

M5 — the word cycle's encounter surface, unchanged: the shipped compact popover (320pt, system chrome + arrow, anchored to the word rect). Headword SF 28 bold, serif reserved for the translation line (brandText teal). Keep = the only FSRS entry — deliberate, never auto. Popup must receive real TappedWordContext so separable verbs resolve (§3.2 addendum).

M6 — the payoff: your line renders as YOUR bubble in the dialogue theatre (alignment = speaker cue, same glass bubbles), then the authored story resumes — the pick never branches the plot (§2.1). Objective ticks; counts, never percents. Audio + karaoke pick back up exactly where the scene stopped.

M7 — §3: when PCC is unusable (offline / quota / cloud turned off in Settings) the mode is ABSENT, with one quiet line why — the PCCQuotaBanner voice. Never present-and-failing, never a disabled dead control. Decided once at lesson start; mid-lesson a missed prefetch degrades that round to plain Listen silently.

M8 — mirrors the lesson recap so the exit is one language: acts as counts that route (2 of 3 worked → the act to revisit), words met in the acts proposed for a deliberate Keep (never auto-saved), your kept words confirmed, and a simple next-story hand-off — same theme, „contains N of your words“ — no recommendation engine.

The data story, per the owner's three cases: (1) bundle ships story+TTS+can-do+optional authored acts[]; a deterministic derived floor means acts always exist. (2) PCC writes options+rationales ahead of play — act 1 in loading, acts 2–3 prefetched in round 1. (3) Cloud can't help → absent mode / silent per-round fallback / later on-device tier (§9 owner call pending).
